senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; שפח, cmp. ספח)family, kinship. Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Noah 24 (play on שפה, Gen. XI, 1) מ׳ אחת one kinship (all equally bad, cmp. preced. w.).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 109b:5">B. Bath. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>מִשְׁפַּחַת אב קרויה מ׳</he> the father’s kinship is called one’s family (not the mother’s).

<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 8:7">Eduy. VIII, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 71a:9">Kidd. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>משפחת בית וכ׳</he> (not <he>משפחות</he>) a family named Beth &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִשְׁפָּחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 1:3">Tosef. Naz. I, 3</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="C00885"><he>גָּלָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
